important_items: I1 Ownership: every amendment/new ADR has exactly one landing sprint (no orphans/dups) BUT ADR-0016 (r-4, r-1, r-3b) and ADR-0019 (r-2, r-2b) share one Status line per subsection while individual bullets flip Active at different sprints — split into per-sprint subsections.
I2 Order: r-4 first sound for 0023 pins/0007 numbers/0017 two-binary table/0016 =1.5.0 text; NOT for the 0005 narrowing (ARCH-002) or the compose-pin line in 0023 (ARCH-008).
I3 docs/architecture.md and docs/requirements.md owned only by r-4 but every sprint edits them to flip statuses; r-1 ∥ r-4 claim untrue — add as section-scoped owned_paths or serialize flips.

I4 Disjointness: r-2 vs r-3 — r-3 d5 edits sc-jev-check registry/mod.rs (r-2) and sc-jev-backends backend.rs/wire.rs (r-2b-owned) while declared parallel; r-2b vs r-3b — r-2b adds --chain-context flag and Python kwarg in files r-3b owns and rewrites in parallel. Fix: give r-3b the flag/kwarg, or r-3b must_follow r-2b.
I5 r-1 states the a-1 module-freeze override explicitly — pass.

I6 ADR-0026 should state ADR-0012 (sc-jev owns every Jev HTTP operation) still holds while physical send moves to sc-agent-http; r-5 re-encoding canonical object inside sc-jev to compute input_sha256 sits against ADR-0005 — hash received bundle bytes or add attestation-only carve-out.
I7 plan.md frontmatter adrs not the union of sprint lists (0001, 0002, 0004, 0018 missing); docs/sc-jev-py/architecture.md:25 still names run::build_request and no sprint owns that doc.
